description: This file contains benchmark configurations and classes for quantized 2D pooling operations (MaxPool2d, AvgPool2d, AdaptiveAvgPool2d) using PyTorch, including setup for different input sizes, data types, and contiguity options.

classes.name: _QPool2dBenchmarkBase
classes.description: Base class for quantized 2D pooling benchmarks, handling input setup and quantization.

classes.name: QMaxPool2dBenchmark
classes.description: Benchmark class for quantized MaxPool2d operation.

classes.name: QAvgPool2dBenchmark
classes.description: Benchmark class for quantized AvgPool2d operation.

classes.name: QAdaptiveAvgPool2dBenchmark
classes.description: Benchmark class for quantized AdaptiveAvgPool2d operation.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares input tensor, quantizes it, and permutes if non-contiguous.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the pooling operation with specific parameters.
